newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Hoyts says will meet forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Hoyts says will meet forecasts.

text.p: Cinema operator Hoyts Cinemas Group Ltd said on Thursday that it expected to meet its prospectus earnings forecast for the year to June 1997.
It also said that so far this financial year it was ahead of budget in Australia but was behind in its U.S. operations.

"Based on our position today, and the product becoming available in the remainder of the financial year, we expect to meet our earnings forecast for the 12 month period to June 30, 1997," Hoyts chairman David Gonski told the annual meeting.
"In Australia we are ahead of budget, although we are behind in the United States because of the Olympics," he said.
"But the November figures both in Australia and in the United States have been encouraging," he said.
